standard.summary: 手动把模型中的 2D 主体权重拆成 residual
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Manually splits the model's 2D principal weights into a residual
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 手动把模型中的 2D 主体权重拆成 residual checkpoint + PiSSA/LoRA 初始化文件。

advanced_en.principle: Manually splits a model's 2D principal weights into a residual checkpoint plus PiSSA/LoRA initialization files.
